component.name: Shrutadhara
component.summary: Record meetings and preserve conversations locally

description.p: Hear everything. Preserve knowledge. Remember what matters with private local meeting recordings.
Shrutadhara records separate microphone and Teams participant audio on Linux desktops with PipeWire and PulseAudio compatibility. Prepare recordings locally and retain the original audio.

This experimental Flatpak supports recording and local preparation. AI transcription and notes require the native application and a separately configured agy installation. Give participants notice and obtain permission before recording.
